results.title: Python Official Documentation
results.snippet: Python is a programming language. The official documentation covers the Python tutorial, language reference, standard library, and installation.

results.title: HTTPX Documentation
results.snippet: HTTPX is an HTTP client for Python. It supports synchronous and asynchronous requests, connection pooling, timeouts, and HTTP status handling.

results.title: Pydantic Documentation
results.snippet: Pydantic validates data using Python type annotations. Models support field constraints, structured validation errors, and JSON schema generation.
